race.comment: ARMA THE GREAT (9) moderate effort at this track two runs ago then settled back and failed to figure at his latest appearance over 1740m at this track, beaten 13 metres into fourth. Shouldn't spend a penny from this draw and the sprint lane may come in handy. Meets a similar quality field and is good enough to win a race of this calibre. YANKEE BABE (7) finished seventh last start over 1740m at this track, beaten 17 metres, after a modest seventh at this track the run prior. Must overcome a very wide draw. Primary contender if anywhere near her best. SHALLOW POCKETS (8) must be considered after he finished runner-up over 1740m at this track a week ago. SOLVE THE CRIME (5) was not a factor most recently in a richer race over 1740m at this track. Gets chance.
